item.title: Yankees announce 2026 coaching staff

item.title: YANKEES RE-SIGN RHP PAUL BLACKBURN
item.description: The New York Yankees today announced that they have re-signed right-handed pitcher Paul Blackburn to a one-year Major League contract. Blackburn, 32, went 0-3 with one save and a 6.23 ERA (39.0IP, 47H, 29R/27ER, 12BB, 34K, 6HR) in 15 combined games (four starts) with the Mets and Yankees in 2025. item.title: Yankees claim INF/OF Marco Luciano off waivers from Orioles
item.description: Earlier today, the Yankees claimed INF/OF Marco Luciano off waivers from the Baltimore Orioles. item.title: Yankees Resign INF/OF Cody Bellinger
item.description: The New York Yankees today announced that they have re-signed infielder/outfielder Cody Bellinger to a five-year Major League contract with two player opt-outs.
